result.title: PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency
result.summary: Looped language models reuse one block of weights T times per token, trading parameters for test-time depth, but autoregressive decoding then pays T sequential passes per token. Self-speculative decoders recover 2-10x for a single request, yet their gains fade as requests share a GPU, and current practice is to speculate less as load grows. We show that what fails under load is the layout of speculative work, not speculation. In concurrent decoding the unit of cost is the row, one request advancing on one loop, which reads that loop's key-value (KV) cache once; additional positions inside a row are nearly free. Pipelined schedules such as the wavefront place every speculative position on a different loop, hence in a row of its own, so each token is still read T times. We present PackLoop, built on one principle: speculate only inside rows that are read anyway. Deep loops accumulate positions and advance them as a block in one row, context-copy proposals join the row that the first loop already reads, and a closed-form admission rule, the economic order quantity of inventory theory, sets how long to accumulate from a cost model calibrated once per engine. PackLoop is exact: in FP32 its output is token-for-token identical to autoregressive decoding, also under sampling and early exit. Across 164 load points spanning three GPUs, four Ouro models, six benchmarks, and contexts up to 32K tokens, one PackLoop configuration is faster than the best existing schedule, chosen per point, at 161 points (median 1.25x, up to 1.76x) and never significantly slower. Its lead grows with concurrency and context length, the regime in which existing self-speculation gains least.

AI.brief_summary: 研究 Looped 语言模型在并发解码下的效率问题，指出负载下真正失效的是投机工作的布局而非投机本身，提出 PackLoop：只在本来就要读取的行内做投机，并以 EOQ 闭式准入规则决定累积长度，在 FP32、采样与早退下仍与自回归解码逐 token 一致。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按代价模型标定的「累积多久再成块推进」准入规则与早退下的精确解码，可能为 LVR 中 loop 步数分配、动态计算预算与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 停止决策提供可供核查的借鉴；但论文本身面向服务吞吐，不涉及视觉证据或多模态状态内容。
